title: Senior technical writer (API docs, docs-as-code)
description: A 5-year API-documentation technical writer evaluated against 8 postings: one strong docs match with structured-authoring gaps, one semantic match phrased entirely in generic vocabulary, one marginal UX-writing role, and five distractors across engineering, marketing, and sales.
rationale: This scenario stresses a non-engineering resume (technical writer) plus the semantic case family. j2 is the constructed semantic match: it describes the resume's exact core competency — developer-facing documentation kept in version-controlled authoring workflows with lightweight plain-text markup and peer-reviewed content changes — while sharing almost no tokens with the resume's skill names (no 'Markdown', 'docs-as-code', 'Git', 'OpenAPI', 'Docusaurus'), so TF-IDF has little signal but embeddings should rank it, hence grade 2. j1 is the gap target: strong overlap on API reference docs, OpenAPI, Markdown, Git, and docs-as-code justifies grade 3, while required DITA XML and JavaScript docs-tooling work are clear high-severity gaps, with preferred GraphQL documentation and video production as low-severity gaps. j3 (UX writer) shares real writing craft but a different job family and deliverable, hence grade 1. The remaining five jobs (backend, social media, data analysis, QA automation, sales) are graded 0 with no core overlap.

jobs.raw_text:
Senior Technical Writer, Developer Docs — Fernwave (Remote, US)

Fernwave builds payments infrastructure APIs used by 3,000 platforms. We are hiring a Senior Technical Writer to own our public developer documentation.

What you will do:
- Own reference documentation and integration guides for our public REST APIs
- Maintain the Markdown docs-as-code pipeline and the developer style guide
- Migrate enterprise PDF deliverables into a DITA-based component content management system
- Customize documentation-site components and build scripts in JavaScript

Requirements: API reference documentation, OpenAPI, Git-based docs-as-code workflow, DITA XML, JavaScript for docs tooling. 5+ years writing developer documentation and 2+ years maintaining a docs-as-code toolchain. Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Computer Science, or equivalent, plus a portfolio of developer-facing documentation.

Nice to have: GraphQL API documentation, video tutorial production, localization workflow management.

jobs.raw_text:
Developer Content Specialist — Traceform (Hybrid, Portland OR)

Traceform makes observability tooling for engineering teams, and our developer-facing documentation has fallen behind the product. We care about craft and workflow fit, not which specific tools you have used — ours are easy to pick up.

You will create reference material, tutorials, and troubleshooting guides for a developer audience, keep all content in the same version control system our engineers use with changes reviewed like code, turn machine-readable interface specifications into readable reference pages, and publish through an automated static publishing pipeline.

We look for: strong developer-facing writing, comfort with version-controlled authoring workflows, fluency in lightweight plain-text markup, and the habit of peer-reviewing content changes. 3+ years creating content for software developers. Bonus: automated prose linting, experience running a static publishing pipeline.
